name: Yuricia Albert
original_name: ユリィシア・アルベルト
source:
This work's protagonist. Female. The reincarnated form of a necromancer originally known as the [King of the Abyss]. He failed in the secret technique to become an undead king, but succeeded in reincarnating himself into the womb of the nearby Flora.

She has a fairly unique code of ethics that is as follows:

　- Healing magic is used to strengthen her magical ability

　- She judges others based on their compatibility with the undead

　- Hot guys should die

　- Using powerful magic is ecstasy

She possesses a fairly destructive nature.

However, for whatever reason, what she does and achieves benefits the world and people, so those who adore her are endless. Therefore, she is called Light of Endeside and Angel of Reunir. She maintains a lot of cheat abilities, but her combat ability is basically nonexistent.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211320]Steam[/url]]
